Reasoning: The material states that Zhangmu Port is located at the southern foot of the Himalayas and belongs to a mountainous area. Roads in mountain valleys usually need to conform to the direction of mountain slopes and river valleys and reduce gradients, so it is difficult to build them as straight lines, and they will present a winding and coiling form. Therefore, the winding roads in the Zhangmu Port area are mainly affected by terrain.
